items.original_text: Imagine Tur.ai’s AI analytics revealing in real-time what shoppers crave next. This allows you to align inventory with these emerging trends effortlessly, optimizing the product mix for market demand. As a result, +5% to Global Sales Productivity.
items.new_text: Tur.ai uses models matched to each task rather than one model for everything. Governed execution limits unnecessary retries. In one banking engagement, annual token spend fell from €1.8M to €300K. This is AI usage spend, not total ownership cost.
items.reason: Task-matched models and governed execution; token spend is not total TCO.

items.original_text: What can we expect in terms of improving our first response to customer inquiries?

items.original_text: Picture a customer inquiring about the status of a large order. Traditionally, this might require manual checks and cause delays. With Tur.ai, such inquiries will be instantly processed by AI, providing immediate, accurate updates to customers, reducing wait times, and significantly boosting satisfaction from the first interaction. As a result, +90% Initial Contact Resolution
items.new_text: Selected banking results, not a forecast for every deployment: onboarding fell from 16 to 6 days, with staffing needs from 34 to 6 FTE. A separate engagement cut annual token spend from €1.8M to €300K. The 3x figure measures process-delivery speed, not onboarding time. FTE describes required capacity, not confirmed headcount cuts.
items.reason: Explain denominators and distinct engagements in an existing FAQ.
